values: Illustrative first 12 trading months. AUD. No sales history or supplier quotes.
Founder-built model. Change yellow inputs; review margin, acquisition cost and funding together.
All monthly drivers are assumptions. New customers pay once in their joining month.
Opening subscribers churn before renewal; retained subscribers may skip without cancelling.
Fractional customers represent expected values. The plan uses calendar-month subscriptions.
Fixed overhead: $350 software, $400 facility/admin access, $500 insurance/accounting/support.
CAC includes paid media, affiliate costs, allocated content and promotions; do not add them twice.
Returning one-time customers are separate orders. No one-time-to-subscription conversion is assumed.
Owner labour is a cost allowance from Month 4, not a full salary or a tax calculation.
Headroom excludes the protected $5,000 reserve. See Launch budget for timing limitations.
